metadata.title: EPUB 3.3 Error Fix Precision Guide (Developer Logic Edition)
metadata.description: 251 error codes updated with strict, algorithmic, and developer-centric execution logic.

global_rules.philosophy: Validation is priority. If a feature causes an error and cannot be fixed deterministically, disable or remove it.
global_rules.standard_compliance: Enforce W3C EPUB 3.3 and HTML5 standards.
global_rules.data_integrity: Preserve text content. If a tag is invalid, try to unwrap the text before deleting the tag.
global_rules.action_priority: 1. Fix (if deterministic). 2. Fallback (safe default). 3. Delete (if corrupt/blocking).
global_rules.cascade_delete: When deleting a file, ALWAYS remove its entry in content.opf <manifest> and remove all references (link, img, src) in XHTML/CSS.

ACC-001.hint: Algorithm: Check if the image has a caption. If yes, use caption text as 'alt'. If no, set alt='' (empty string) to mark as decorative.

ACC-002.description: Input element not referenced by label
ACC-002.hint: Algorithm: Generate a random ID (e.g., 'input_123'). Add id='input_123' to <input>. Create <label for='input_123' style='display:none'>Form Label</label> immediately before the input.

ACC-013.hint: Action: Move style content to a new class in the linked CSS file. If no CSS exists, create 'style.css', link it, and move styles there.

ACC-014.hint: Regex Replace: Convert 'px' to 'em'. Formula: px_value / 16. (e.g., 16px -> 1em, 12px -> 0.75em).

ACC-015.hint: Regex Replace: Remove 'px' from line-height. Example: 'line-height: 24px' -> 'line-height: 1.5'.

ACC-016.hint: Action: Replace absolute units (pt, cm, in) with 'em' or 'rem'.

CHK-008.hint: Critical: The file cannot be processed. Treat as PKG-021 (Corrupted): Delete file and Cascade Delete all references.

CSS-001.hint: Regex Delete: Remove any property line matching /^-epub-/i.

CSS-002.hint: Regex Delete: Remove any CSS property line containing `url('')`, `url("")`, or `url()`.

CSS-003.hint: Action: Open file, decode as detected encoding, re-encode and save as UTF-8.

CSS-004.hint: Action: Save file as 'UTF-8' (Standard), not 'UTF-8 with BOM'.

CSS-005.hint: Logic: If two identical properties exist in one block, delete the first one (keep the last one due to CSS cascade rules).

CSS-006.hint: Hard Replace: Change `position: fixed` to `position: absolute`. (Fixed layout breaks pagination).

CSS-007.hint: Action: If font format is not ttf/otf/woff/woff2, delete the @font-face block.

CSS-008.hint: Action: Use a CSS validator/formatter library to auto-correct syntax (e.g., missing brackets). If fails, comment out the problematic block.

CSS-010.hint: Regex Replace: In HTML, find <link ... rel="stylesheet">. Ensure/Add type="text/css".

CSS-012.hint: Optimization: Consolidate content of all CSS files into one 'style.css' and update links. (Optional: Ignore).

CSS-013.hint: Regex Remove: Remove the string '!important' from CSS values.

CSS-015.hint: Action: In XHTML, find <link rel='alternate stylesheet'>. Add attribute title='Alternate Style'.

CSS-017.hint: Ignore (Warning only). If layout is broken, manually inspect.

CSS-019.hint: Regex Delete: Remove `@font-face { }` blocks that contain no properties.

CSS-021.hint: Action: Change font-family to generic 'serif' or 'sans-serif'.

CSS-022.hint: Action: Delete `* { margin: ... }` rule. Explicitly set margins on `body` instead.

CSS-023.hint: Action: Remove media queries using non-standard features (e.g., -webkit-device-pixel-ratio).

CSS-024.hint: Optimization: Remove the CSS class definition. (Safe to ignore for validation).

CSS-025.hint: Action: Create an empty CSS rule for the missing class to suppress the error: `.missing-class {}`.

CSS-028.hint: Security Logic: If src url points to .exe, .bin, .bat, DELETE the entire @font-face block.

HTM-029.hint: Action: If label exists, set `for` attribute to match input's ID. If no ID, generate one.
